_comment: Python ML runtime. Unlike kali-factory, the unit of work is Python code — this manifest describes available libraries, not a shell-binary allowlist. The container itself is the security boundary (non-root, dropped caps, read-only rootfs, tmpfs /work, no host volumes by default).

_planned_jobs._comment: These are the wired job types for the python-ml service when it lands. v0.0.4 ships the image; the service shape comes next.

python_run.description: Execute a Python script with optional argv; capture stdout, stderr, return JSON-serializable result if the script defines `result`.

embed.description: Run sentence-transformers on a list of strings, return vectors.

dataframe_op.description: Apply a declarative pandas/polars op chain to a dataset, return summary or write to /work.

train_sklearn.description: Fit a sklearn estimator on a dataset, persist artifact, return metrics.

predict.description: Load a persisted model artifact, run inference on inputs, return predictions.
